findings.description: run_realtime retains the RealtimeGrant, including the bearer ticket, through the entire post-upgrade session and unconditionally returns Expired at the original grant expiry. Drop the ticket immediately after constructing the handshake request and apply expiry only to the WebSocket upgrade; authenticated session lifetime is governed separately.

realtime_one_attempt_sends_cached_state_first_and_decodes_lifecycle compares the captured full Authorization bearer value with assert_eq!. A mismatch panic prints both strings, exposing the bearer ticket in test or CI output. Compare a non-secret boolean or fingerprint instead.
